messages:
Alex: Heads up — invoice preview for tenant T-42 is showing ~30% more tokens than the final invoice. Spotted after yesterday's route-resolver rollout.

Priya: I saw the same on the preview dashboard. Seems like fallback_priority header got introduced but the preview aggregator doesn't treat it consistently.

Sam: Is there any sign of duplicate events? Or is this strictly attribution mis-keying?

Alex: Sample event (sanitized):
```json
{
  \"tenant_id\": \"T-42\",
  \"route_tag\": \"nlp-us\",
  \"fallback_priority\": \"low\",
  \"tokens\": 312,
  \"timestamp\": 1718911200
}
```

Morgan: Short version: route-resolver canary started attaching fallback_priority to requests. Downstream aggregator uses (tenant_id, route_tag) as the attribution key, but preview ingestion is using the raw envelope that sometimes includes fallback_priority in the grouping key. Result: some events get split and then re-aggregated differently across preview vs billing pipelines.

Ingrid: That matches why invoice totals are unchanged (billing pipeline canonicalizes route tags) but preview is inflated — preview ingestion path didn't normalize the new field.

Priya: We have a 'route-normalizer' transform service that strips/normalizes extra attributes, but it's only rolled out to us-west. EU region missed the deployment (drift).

QA Bot: Deployment scan -> route-normalizer v1.3.2 present in us-west/us-east, absent in eu-west. Canary flag set for 2024-06-18 03:12 UTC.

OpsBot: Created INC-2024-238 and paged oncall to investigate preview/billing delta.

Sam: Proposed fixes:
- Make aggregator attribution key explicit and backward-compatible (drop fallback_priority)
- Add normalization step in preview ingestion to canonicalize incoming envelopes
- Backfill normalized aggregation for last 72h for affected tenant windows
- Add alert: preview_delta_pct > 5% for tenants with monthly spend > $1k

Morgan: I can own aggregator change (PR incoming). Plan: add a compatibility layer that maps (tenant, route_tag, fallback_priority) -> (tenant, canonical_route) so both pipelines converge. We'll gate with a feature-flag and add a replay unit test.

Priya: For the missing route-normalizer in eu-west — we should deploy v1.3.3 that explicitly drops unknown envelope fields by default. Ops, can you sync?

OpsBot: K8s rollout request created: k8s/rollout/route-normalizer/eu-west v1.3.3. ETA 30m.

Ingrid: Billing note — this is preview-only, invoices are OK. We still need a customer comms plan if previews are visible in workspace. Please add a console banner for affected workspaces: 'Invoice preview may be inconsistent for a short period due to a normalization rollout.'

Alex: Backfill compute question: Sam, can you estimate cost/ETA for replaying 72h of preview events through normalizer?

Sam: Rough ballpark: ~6 CPU-hours for the window per region, 2TB IO. If we parallelize by shard we can finish in ~90 minutes. I'll add a job spec to the PR.

Morgan: I'll add the replay job as a one-off in the pipeline and include a dry-run mode to validate delta before applying.

Priya: UX ask — can the console show an annotation on the preview chart when we flip the feature flag? That would help CS/PMs.

Morgan: Yes — I'll wire a simple event to the console events API on flag flip.

Ingrid: I'll inform sales/CS and ask them not to escalate until the backfill completes.

Alex: Thanks all. Action items: Sam PR -> aggregator key (assign Morgan), Ops rollout route-normalizer eu-west, Sam job spec for backfill, Morgan console annotation + feature-flag gating, Ingrid customer comms.

Priya: Also, can we add a regression test in the preview-integrations test matrix to inject unknown envelope fields? Cc @QA Bot.

QA Bot: Test matrix updated: preview-integrations -> include unknown-envelope-fields case, run in PR pre-merge checks.

Sam: Opening the PR now. tagging @Morgan for review.

Alex: :thumbsup:
